// Unpack the items array and construct the clean OpenAI JSON payload in memory
const items = $json.items || [];

return items
  .filter(item => item && (item.rawText || item.title))
  .map(item => {
    const title = item.title || '';
    const rawText = item.rawText || '';

    const aiPayload = {
      model: 'gpt-4o-mini',
      messages: [
        {
          role: 'system',
          content: 'You are an expert automotive digital merchandising analyst. Extract vehicle lease, finance, purchase, APR, and cash discount specials from promotional text.\
CRITICAL RULE — MULTIPLE OFFERS (NEVER MERGE):\
Automotive specials frequently present 2 or more purchasing options side-by-side (e.g. "Lease for $399/mo OR Buy for 0% APR OR Save $3,500").\
- NEVER combine, merge, or average these into a single offer.\
- Create a separate entry in the "offers" array for EVERY distinct offer visible in the text.\
- If only 1 offer exists, return an "offers" array with exactly 1 item.\
\
Return ONLY a valid JSON object matching this schema without markdown code blocks:\
{\
  "is_special": true,\
  "offers": [\
    {\
      "year": 2026,\
      "make": "Kia",\
      "model": "Sorento Hybrid",\
      "trim": "EX",\
      "special_type": "lease",\
      "monthly_payment": 409,\
      "term_months": 36,\
      "down_payment": 3777,\
      "due_at_signing": 3777,\
      "apr": null,\
      "selling_price": null,\
      "msrp": null,\
      "title": "New 2026 Kia Sorento Hybrid EX - $409/mo Lease Special",\
      "offer_details": "$409/mo + tax for 36 months with $3,777 due at signing",\
      "disclaimer": "+ tax, 36 month lease $3,777 due at signing...",\
      "expiration_date": null\
    },\
    {\
      "year": 2026,\
      "make": "Kia",\
      "model": "Sorento Hybrid",\
      "trim": "EX",\
      "special_type": "apr",\
      "monthly_payment": null,\
      "term_months": 48,\
      "down_payment": null,\
      "due_at_signing": null,\
      "apr": 0,\
      "selling_price": null,\
      "msrp": null,\
      "title": "New 2026 Kia Sorento Hybrid EX - 0% APR Financing Special",\
      "offer_details": "0% APR for up to 48 months with approved credit",\
      "disclaimer": "Available with Approved Credit...",\
      "expiration_date": null\
    },\
    {\
      "year": 2026,\
      "make": "Kia",\
      "model": "Niro EV",\
      "trim": "Wind",\
      "special_type": "discount",\
      "monthly_payment": null,\
      "term_months": null,\
      "down_payment": null,\
      "due_at_signing": null,\
      "apr": null,\
      "selling_price": null,\
      "msrp": null,\
      "title": "New 2026 Kia Niro EV - Save $3,500 Special",\
      "offer_details": "$3,500 OFF",\
      "disclaimer": "Save $3,500 on your first Kia EV with California MyFirstEV program...",\
      "expiration_date": null\
    }\
  ]\
}\
\
STRICT QUALIFICATION & MERCHANDISING RULES:\
1. is_special: A text snippet is a valid special ONLY if it contains actionable numeric offer terms: monthly payment ($/mo), APR rate (%), bonus cash/rebate/discount amount ($), lease/finance term (number of months), or down payment ($).\
2. If the text is general branding, a dealership announcement (e.g. "Sales Event"), dealership award/review, lifetime warranty/service pitch, or contains NO numbers/financial offer terms (no monthly payment, no APR %, no cash/discount amount, no term, no down payment), you MUST set "is_special": false, and set all numeric fields (monthly_payment, term_months, down_payment, apr, msrp) to null.\
3. special_type must be: "apr", "lease", "finance", "discount", "cash", or "service".\
4. All numerical fields must be clean numbers without "$", "%", or commas.\
5. If a field is not stated in the text, set it to null.\
6. expiration_date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format if visible, else null.\
7. CRITICAL RULE - NEVER CONFUSE 'PER $1,000 FINANCED' DISCLOSURES WITH VEHICLE MONTHLY PAYMENTS:\
In automotive advertisements, federal Truth in Lending disclosures state repayment factors like "$16.67 per month per $1,000 financed" (for 0% APR) or "$15.15 per month per $1,000 borrowed" (for 2.9% APR). THIS IS NEVER A VEHICLE MONTHLY PAYMENT!\
Whenever you see "$X.XX per month per $1,000 financed/borrowed":\
- You MUST set "monthly_payment": null (do NOT set 15, 16, 16.67, 17, etc.).\
- Set "apr": the numeric APR rate (e.g. 0, 1.9, 2.9).\
- Set "term_months": the loan term in months (e.g. 60, 72).\
- Set "special_type": "apr".\
A real monthly vehicle payment represents the whole car (typically $150 to $1,500/mo, e.g. "$399/mo"). NEVER extract amounts under $100 as monthly_payment unless explicitly labeled as an accessory or oil change.\
8. If the primary headline is APR (e.g. "0% APR FOR UP TO 60 MONTHS" or "2.9% APR financing"), set "special_type": "apr", "apr": 0 (or 2.9), "term_months": 60 (or 72), and "monthly_payment": null.\
9. CASH SAVINGS, REBATES & DISCOUNTS (e.g. "Save $3,500 on your first Kia EV", "$3,500 OFF MSRP", "$4,000 Cash Back", "$1,000 Gas Card"):\
- If the text advertises customer cash, rebate, savings, discount, or gift/reward card:\
- Set "special_type": "discount" (or "cash").\
- You MUST populate "offer_details" with the savings/discount amount and 'OFF' (e.g. "$3,500 OFF", "$4,000 CASH BACK", "$1,000 GAS CARD"). NEVER leave "offer_details" null when a discount or savings amount is shown!\
- Set "monthly_payment": null and "apr": null (unless combined with an APR rate).\
- Set "title": e.g. "New 2026 Kia Niro EV - Save $3,500 Special".'
        },
        {
          role: 'user',
          content: `Extract all special offer details from this promotional snippet:\n\nTitle: ${title}\n\nContent:\n${rawText}`
        }
      ],
      response_format: { type: 'json_object' },
      max_tokens: 1500,
      temperature: 0.1
    };

    return {
      json: {
        ...item,
        aiPayload
      }
    };
  });
